instruction: Complete the full FEniCS workflow from modeling to post-processing: 1. Write Python script `/home/user/Desktop/poisson_full.py`: - Create a `1×1` unit-square mesh with 64 subdivisions in each direction using `UnitSquareMesh(64, 64)` - Define a P1 Lagrange space - Define variational problem: `-Δu = sin(πx)*sin(πy)`, with boundary `u=0` - Compute L2 error against the analytical solution `sin(πx)*sin(πy)/(2π²)` - Extract the maximum P1 nodal coefficient 2. Run `poisson_full.py`. 3. Save L2 error and maximum nodal value to `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt`: Format: `error_L2, max_nodal_value` [Software] Run your script with Python in the legacy FEniCS/DOLFIN 2019.1.0 environment (e.g. `from dolfin import *`). At the start of the task, run legacy FEniCS with `/home/user/miniconda3/bin/conda run --no-capture-output --prefix /home/user/miniconda3/envs/fenics-legacy python` when working on `poisson_full.py`.
